args.prompt:
Decide whether the EVIDENCE supports the CLAIM. Judge only the evidence text; ignore your own knowledge.
EXPLICIT = the evidence directly states the claim.
IMPLICIT = the evidence clearly implies the claim without stating it.
NONE = the evidence only mentions the subject, or does not support the claim.
CLAIM: "Boedo" is worth visiting for travellers interested in history.
EVIDENCE: """Boedo A neighbourhood that pays homage to an independence hero, was home to an important literary set, and brims with Porteño tango identity. This neighbourhood bears the name of the independence hero Mariano Joaquín Boedo, a lawyer who was active in the events of July 9, 1816 and was one of the men who signed the declaration of independence from Spain."""
Reply with one JSON object: {"level":"EXPLICIT|IMPLICIT|NONE","rationale":"<one sentence>"}
